comment: Capability labels and status meanings for the Controller web Library and `vonkctl recipe detail`. `vocabulary` is what the contract publishes (`catalog_vocabulary()`; the vonkctl test fails when it drifts, regenerate it from that call). The web test renders each case under that vocabulary and compares the capability chips' text and titles and the status badge title; the vonkctl test renders the same input and compares the printed `Usage` and `Meaning` lines. Both must equal the literals here exactly. A capability the release does not list shows its name; none declared shows `Not reported`.
